name: Gathering 'Jingsang' Mulberry Leaves
summary: This painting is from an album depicting the silk industry. It shows men climbing up ladders to gather the 'jingsang' mulberry leaves which are used to feed silkworms. The 'jingsang' is a tall mulberry tree with a strong trunk commonly grown in north China.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
